_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.landing. Covers the public landing page at `/` (LP-AUTH). The page is a one-screen splash visitors see when they deep-link / bookmark `https://auth.xynes.com/`.
_meta.audience: First-time visitors landing on the auth-app root URL — most have arrived via a password manager, a bookmark, or a deep-link from another Xynes app.
_meta.tone: Direct and confident. Avoid marketing fluff. Concrete verbs and concrete numbers only.
_meta.security: All copy renders as plain text via `next-intl` — never with `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. CTAs land on `/login` and `/signup` (auth-internal). The `auth-sdk on GitHub` link is external. Translation values MUST NOT carry raw secrets, tokens, internal IDs, or stack traces.

meta._use: HTML `<title>` + `<meta name="description">`. Visible in search results and browser tabs.
meta.title: Browser-tab title. Keep ≤ 60 characters after translation.
meta.description: Search-engine meta description. Keep ≤ 155 characters after translation.

nav._use: Top sticky nav rendered by `<MarketingNav>` from `@lumia-ui/marketing`.
nav.ariaLabel: Accessible label for the `<nav>` landmark. Defaults to `Primary` per LP-DS contract; translate as the screen-reader equivalent of "main navigation".
nav.brandLabel: Accessible label for the brand mark link in the nav. Reads to a screen reader as e.g. "xynes home — link".

hero._use: Hero block at the top of the page. The headline is the only `<h1>` on `/`.
hero.ariaLabel: Accessible label for the `<section>` landmark (used when the headline is rendered as a wordmark brand mark rather than text).
hero.headline: Primary headline. Should fit on one line at 1440 × 900 viewport.
hero.subhead: One-sentence positioning copy under the headline. Plain text; no rich content.
hero.primaryCta: Primary CTA — lands on `/login`. Use a verb ("Sign in" / "Log in").
hero.secondaryCta: Secondary CTA — lands on `/signup`. Use an active phrase that signals account creation.
hero.footnote: Small trust line under the CTA row. Keep neutral and factual; do not promise features the product does not have.

features._use: Three-column feature grid rendered by `<MarketingFeatureGrid columns={3}>`. Each card carries an icon + headline + 2-line body.
features.ariaLabel: Accessible label for the `<section>` landmark when no visible heading is rendered.

workspaceScoped._use: First card. Icon: shield-check. Speaks to the workspace-as-permission-boundary model.
workspaceScoped.headline: Short title. "One Workspace, Clear Access" is the canonical phrasing.
workspaceScoped.body: ≤ 2 lines on desktop. Explain workspace switching, teammates, and permission boundaries in human terms.

sso._use: Second card. Icon: globe. Speaks to single sign-on across Xynes apps.
sso.headline: Short title. Should signal cross-app movement from Workspace Admin into CMS Console and future apps.
sso.body: ≤ 2 lines on desktop. Mention CMS Console as the current adjacent product; avoid inventing shipped app surfaces.

openSource._use: Third card. Icon: code. Speaks to the open-source posture.
openSource.headline: Short title. "Built In The Open" is the canonical phrasing.
openSource.body: ≤ 2 lines on desktop. Mention public repos and security policy; do not invent audit cadence or compliance claims.

trust._use: Trust strip rendered by `<MarketingTrustStrip>`. Lives between the feature grid and the footer.
trust.ariaLabel: Accessible label for the `<aside>` landmark. Translate as the screen-reader equivalent of "trust and security signals".

footer._use: Site footer rendered by `<MarketingFooter>` with 4 columns: Product / Developers / Company / Legal.
footer.copyright: Bottom-row copyright string. Keep year stable (manually updated in catalog) — do not interpolate the current year at runtime so all SSR replicas render the same string.

product.heading: Column heading rendered as `<h3>`.
product.signIn: Link label — same destination as the hero primary CTA.
product.signUp: Link label — same destination as the hero secondary CTA.
product.cmsConsole: External cross-product link label — lands on the CMS Console origin.

developers.heading: Column heading rendered as `<h3>`.
developers.authSdk: External link to the public auth-sdk repo on GitHub.
developers.docs: External link to the public docs site (https://docs.xynes.com).

company.heading: Column heading rendered as `<h3>`.
company.website: External link to the apex marketing site (https://xynes.com).
company.status: External link to the public status page (https://status.xynes.com).

legal.heading: Column heading rendered as `<h3>`.
legal.privacy: External link to https://xynes.com/legal/privacy. The legal copy itself lives on the apex; this page only links.
legal.security: Relative link to /SECURITY.md, served by the auth-app's public root.

cookie._use: Non-blocking sticky cookie disclosure rendered by `<CookieDisclosure>`. NOT a modal. Dismissal persists in `localStorage`, not in a cookie.
cookie.message: Disclosure body. Must accurately describe the cookies the product actually sets. Today only a session cookie is set on sign-in.
cookie.policyLabel: Link label that takes the visitor to the cookie policy page on the apex.
cookie.dismissLabel: Button label that dismisses the disclosure. Translate as the screen-reader equivalent of "acknowledge".
